headline: Generac Tops Q2 Earnings Estimates, Reaffirms 2026 Revenue Outlook
summary: GNRC's Q2 earnings beat estimates as C&I growth, data center demand and tariff refunds have lifted results, while its 2026 sales outlook is reaffirmed.
